_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_n_flies: Flies of the burden-matched comparison with the hub map at reference s = 0.5 (stage 0.5, 48.3% of contacts lost by design).
_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_thinning_pct: Median over the 32 hub flies at s = 0.5 of the contacts removed by synapse thinning (thin_frac), percent of all synaptic contacts of the model (antennal-lobe connections excluded; exp2_burden_matched.py burden(), recomputed from each fly's seed).
_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_removed_neuron_connectio: Median over the same flies of the additional contacts lost through the connections of removed neurons: the contacts that survived thinning on every connection whose presynaptic or postsynaptic neuron was removed (syn_lost_frac - thin_frac, per fly), percent of all synaptic contacts of the model (antennal-lobe connections excluded; exp2_burden_matched.py burden(), recomputed from each fly's seed).
_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_total_pct: Median over the same flies of all contacts lost (syn_lost_frac = thinning + connections of removed neurons), percent of all synaptic contacts of the model (antennal-lobe connections excluded; exp2_burden_matched.py burden(), recomputed from each fly's seed).
_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_sum_of_two_medians_pct: Sum of burden_hub_s0.5_thinning_pct and burden_hub_s0.5_removed_neuron_connections_pct (medians are not additive; compare burden_hub_s0.5_total_pct).
_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_ranges_pct: [min, max] over the 32 flies of [thinning, connections of removed neurons, total], percent of all contacts.
_meaning.burden_hub_s0.5_flies_removed_connection: Flies in which the contacts lost through the connections of removed neurons (after thinning) were at least those removed by thinning [n, of n flies]. A neuron-loss-only fly loses these connections without thinning, so its loss is at least this large.
_meaning.auc_chance_n32_vs_64_sim: Chance level of the direction-free AUC max(AUC, 1 - AUC) for 32 against 64 flies, the severity series (32 flies per severity against 64 healthy): [mean, 95th percentile (numpy linear interpolation), Monte Carlo standard error of the mean] over 20,000 pairs of independent standard normal samples (identical distributions, no ties), numpy default_rng([20261012, 32, 64]). AUC = Mann-Whitney U / (n1 n2) from ranks.
_meaning.auc_chance_n32_vs_64_exact: Same quantity for 32 against 64 flies computed exactly from the null distribution of U without ties (Gaussian binomial coefficients, all 2.970e+25 orderings equally likely): [mean, 95th percentile = smallest value v with P(max(AUC, 1 - AUC) <= v) >= 0.95]. Check of the simulation.
_meaning.auc_chance_n24_vs_32_sim: Chance level of the direction-free AUC max(AUC, 1 - AUC) for 24 against 32 flies, the joint cohort (24 flies per severity against 32 healthy): [mean, 95th percentile (numpy linear interpolation), Monte Carlo standard error of the mean] over 20,000 pairs of independent standard normal samples (identical distributions, no ties), numpy default_rng([20261012, 24, 32]). AUC = Mann-Whitney U / (n1 n2) from ranks.
_meaning.auc_chance_n24_vs_32_exact: Same quantity for 24 against 32 flies computed exactly from the null distribution of U without ties (Gaussian binomial coefficients, all 4.355e+15 orderings equally likely): [mean, 95th percentile = smallest value v with P(max(AUC, 1 - AUC) <= v) >= 0.95]. Check of the simulation.
_meaning.screen_types_tested_distinct: Distinct cell types tested singly in the within-fly screen (48 flies x 450 types; 21600 type rescues).
_meaning.screen_hub_types_rank_mean_ge_0.996: Tested types whose removed neurons are highly connected, mean_rank >= 0.996 averaged over the flies in which the type was tested (mean_rank = mean hub vulnerability rank u of the type's neurons removed in that fly (default hub map; all screen flies use it)): [n types, n that changed none of the six readouts (WB, LH, KC, MBON, MN9, GF) in any fly, i.e. every raw readout bit-identical to the damaged fly in every tested fly, n whose maximum restored fraction over all tested flies and readouts was below 0.05, i.e. restored less than 5% of every kept deficit]. Restored fraction = (y_type - y_damaged) / (y_healthy - y_damaged) per fly; a readout is left out for a fly when |healthy - damaged| <= 5% of |healthy| (either sign kept), as in exp1_stats.py and facts_exp1.json. The unchanged types are a subset of those below 0.05 (80 of 80).
_meaning.screen_hub_types_rank_mean_ge_0.996_vari: Variants for the same 174 types (rank criterion: averaged over the flies in which the type was tested): [n whose restored fraction was exactly 0 for every kept fly-readout pair (a type may still change a readout without a kept deficit), n with |restored fraction| < 0.05 for every kept pair (negative values bounded too), n tested in only one fly, median flies tested].
_meaning.screen_hub_types_rank_anyfly_ge_0.996: Tested types whose removed neurons are highly connected, mean_rank >= 0.996 reached in at least one fly in which the type was tested (mean_rank = mean hub vulnerability rank u of the type's neurons removed in that fly (default hub map; all screen flies use it)): [n types, n that changed none of the six readouts (WB, LH, KC, MBON, MN9, GF) in any fly, i.e. every raw readout bit-identical to the damaged fly in every tested fly, n whose maximum restored fraction over all tested flies and readouts was below 0.05, i.e. restored less than 5% of every kept deficit]. Restored fraction = (y_type - y_damaged) / (y_healthy - y_damaged) per fly; a readout is left out for a fly when |healthy - damaged| <= 5% of |healthy| (either sign kept), as in exp1_stats.py and facts_exp1.json. The unchanged types are a subset of those below 0.05 (89 of 89).
_meaning.screen_hub_types_rank_anyfly_ge_0.996_va: Variants for the same 186 types (rank criterion: reached in at least one fly in which the type was tested): [n whose restored fraction was exactly 0 for every kept fly-readout pair (a type may still change a readout without a kept deficit), n with |restored fraction| < 0.05 for every kept pair (negative values bounded too), n tested in only one fly, median flies tested].
_meaning.screen_hub_types_rank_mean_ge_0.996_list: The types of screen_hub_types_rank_mean_ge_0.996: [type, n flies tested, mean_rank averaged over those flies, changed no readout in any fly, maximum restored fraction over flies and kept readouts], by decreasing rank.
_meaning.calib_malecns_odour_w0.157_active_post_o: MaleCNS base model (no adaptation, recurrent antennal lobe), w_syn = 0.157 mV, left DM1/DM4/VA2 ORNs at 150 Hz for 300 ms (4 replicate brains): [min, max] neurons active per 100-ms bin after stimulus offset, over bins 3 to 9 of the 1-s run (300-1000 ms from onset = 0-700 ms after offset; 7 bins). Active = replicate-mean rate > 0 in the bin.
_meaning.calib_malecns_odour_w0.157_active_per_10: The 7 post-offset bins of the w_syn = 0.157 mV odour run, in order (0-100 ms ... 600-700 ms after offset).
_meaning.calib_malecns_odour_w0.275_active_post_o: MaleCNS base model (no adaptation, recurrent antennal lobe), w_syn = 0.275 mV, left DM1/DM4/VA2 ORNs at 150 Hz for 300 ms (4 replicate brains): [min, max] neurons active per 100-ms bin after stimulus offset, over bins 3 to 9 of the 1-s run (300-1000 ms from onset = 0-700 ms after offset; 7 bins). Active = replicate-mean rate > 0 in the bin.
_meaning.calib_malecns_odour_w0.275_active_per_10: The 7 post-offset bins of the w_syn = 0.275 mV odour run, in order (0-100 ms ... 600-700 ms after offset).
_meaning.calib_malecns_odour_bins_used: Bin indices (0-based, 100-ms bins of the 1-s calibration run) used for the post-offset ranges: bins 0-2 are the 300-ms stimulus, bins 3-9 cover 0-700 ms after offset (calibrate_wsyn.py persistence(): 3000 + 7000 steps of 0.1 ms, bin_steps=1000).

_source.burden_hub_s0.5_thinning_pct: results/exp2/battery.csv rows map=hub, reference=0.5 (condition hub_ref0.5) column thin_frac
_source.burden_hub_s0.5_removed_neuron_connectio: results/exp2/battery.csv rows map=hub, reference=0.5 (condition hub_ref0.5) columns syn_lost_frac - thin_frac
_source.burden_hub_s0.5_total_pct: results/exp2/battery.csv rows map=hub, reference=0.5 (condition hub_ref0.5) column syn_lost_frac
